name: personify
description: Set up AI-assisted support for a GitHub project by following the AI-assistant setup instructions in its README. Usage: @personify OWNER/REPO. Say @personify update to get the latest plugin as a zip.

interface.shortDescription: Set up AI support for a GitHub project from its README
interface.longDescription: Reads the README of a GitHub repository through the GitHub app and, if it contains instructions for AI assistants on setting up AI-powered or AI-assisted support, checks them for security risks or malicious actions and carries them out once you choose Continue. Choosing Cancel makes no changes. Tells you when a newer version is available. Usage: @personify OWNER/REPO. Say @personify update to get the latest plugin as a zip.
